title: DATABASE INDEXING
subtitle: An index turns a scan of every row into a short walk down a tree. Pick the right kind for the query.
footer: System Design, Step by Step · core concepts

items: Several filters: a composite index, ordered by the leftmost-prefix rule.
Distance queries: a geospatial index (R-tree, geohash).
Every index slows writes, so index only the queries you need.
